bms_4168_0800e128.name: bms_frame_rx_byte
bms_4168_0800e128.summary: Feed one received byte into the 0x5A 0xA5 framed parser; return 1 when a frame checks out
bms_4168_0800e128.description: This is a byte-at-a-time receive state machine. Its state is DAT_2000260e, the write index is DAT_20000610, the remaining payload count is DAT_20000611, the staged checksum is DAT_20000612, the valid-frame flag is DAT_2000260f, and the frame buffer starts at 0x2000256D. The frame layout as parsed is 0x5A, 0xA5, LEN (accepted only when below 0x81), a fixed 0x06, a byte that must equal byte 1 of the descriptor at *(DAT_20002608 + 4), a byte chosen by byte 0 of that descriptor (0x01 or '*' expects 0xAA, 0x02 or ',' expects 0xAC, 0xB5 expects 0xB5, 0x07 to 0x0A expect 0x0B), then LEN+1 payload bytes and a little-endian 16-bit checksum. The checksum is the one's complement of the 16-bit byte sum of frame bytes 2 through LEN+6, and a frame is accepted when (~sum) & 0xFFFF equals the received word. Any mismatch resets the state to 0, and a good checksum sets DAT_2000260f to 1 and returns 1 for the closing byte.

returns.description: 1 when this byte completes a frame whose checksum matches, otherwise 0

The byte-0 rule table and the meaning of bytes 3 to 5 are read from constants, so the protocol identity and the meaning of the descriptor are inferred. The only caller is bms_4168_08007c10, and its use of the result is not in this packet.

bms_4168_0801066c.name: bms_j1939_tpcm_abort_pack

The identifier is (0x1CEC0000 + param_2 * 0x100) | param_1, masked to 29 bits, so the priority is 7, the PGN is 0xEC00 (TP.CM), the destination address is param_2 in bits 8 to 15 and the source address is param_1 in bits 0 to 7; bit 31 of the old word is kept and bit 29 is forced to 1. The DLC is set to 8. The data bytes are 0xFF (the connection-abort control byte), 0xFF (the abort reason), three reserved 0xFF bytes, and then 0x00 0xEF 0x00, which is PGN 0x00EF00 in little-endian order in data bytes 5 to 7.

returns.description: 1 when the frame was written, 0 when param_3 is null

bms_4168_0801066c.notes: The protocol identity rests on the constants: 0x1CEC is TP.CM at priority 7, and control byte 0xFF is a connection abort. The reason byte 0xFF is not one of the usual J1939-21 reason codes, so the intent is uncertain. As in bms_can_pack_ext_frame, the handling of bits 29 and 31 is unconfirmed, and param_1 and param_2 are not limited to 8 bits.
